title: Construct spatial neighborhoods from coordinates with automatic method selection — build_spatial_network
text: function builds cell-cell spatial network using one four methods ("radius", "knn", "delaunay", "window"). method = "auto", selects method within-sample spatial metrics using empirical decision tree (multi-cohort network evaluation; see .select_method()): baseline knn(k=10, mutual); radius types strongly clustered density fairly uniform; delaunay continuous / large / heterogeneous layouts (optional length gate); window ordered tiled-like FOVs.

NULL / Inf (default): gate knn/delaunay/window. Numeric: keep edges dist <= value. Ignored unless auto gating requested. edge_length_quantile quantile per-cell k-th NN distances max_edge_length = "auto" (default 0.95). n_neighbors integer number spatial neighbors (knn/window search rank post-filter degree cap). Default 10 knn/window (aligned .default_nn_rank() auto baseline). method = "radius" "delaunay", omitted/NULL means degree cap (Inf: keep ball graph / triangulation). title: Select optimal method based on spatial metrics — .select_method
text: Empirical decision tree method = "auto", calibrated multi-cohort within-sample composite (PAS, SI_expr, speed) across ~180 FOVs. Rules applied order; first match wins: Tiled / blocked-like FOV (ordered Clark-Evans R > 1.15 uniform density CV < 0.3, n < 5e4) -> window knn(k=10, mutual). Strong type clustering (cat_morans_I >= 0.4) fairly uniform density (cv_nn_dist < 0.3) -> radius ~3x median 1-NN. Continuous epithelium / holes: large n (>= 2e5), heterogeneous density (cv >= 0.6), space-filling irregular layout -> delaunay optional max_edge_length = "auto". Otherwise baseline -> knn n_neighbors = 10, require_mutual = TRUE. Scoring parallelism (n_jobs) evaluation concern, encoded ; builders still use n_cores.
